svg.title: Furnace won't light? Safe first checks
svg.desc: Billings Home Pros homeowner guide. Gas smell or CO alarm: leave and call 911 from a safe location. Check thermostat and filter per manual; leave ignition repairs to a pro.

g.text: BILLINGS HOME PROS
Furnace won’t light?
Start here.
Safe first checks. Know when to call a pro.
GAS SMELL OR CO ALARM?
Get everyone outside. Call 911 from a safe location.
For suspected gas: no switches, flames, or phones indoors.
Do not go back in until responders say it is safe.
01 CHECK THE THERMOSTAT
Heat mode. Temperature above the room reading.
Follow the manual for batteries or startup delays.
02 LOOK AT THE FILTER
Check monthly. Replace a dirty filter using the manual’s
shutdown steps and the correct filter size and type.
03 STILL NO HEAT? CALL A PRO.
Record visible error codes without removing panels.
No repeated resets, safety bypasses, or DIY ignition repairs.
FULL GUIDE + LOCAL HEATING PROS
BillingsHomePros.com/guides/furnace-wont-light
Sources: ENERGY STAR • CPSC • U.S. DOT / PHMSA
General information • Follow your equipment manual • November 2026
